- The face (black with white dots) has moved to the RIGHT side of the divider
- The charcoal T is now on the LEFT side of the divider

So when the face crosses the divider, it swaps with the charcoal T! The charcoal T is now on the left side in the original face position, and the face is now on the right side.
The charcoal T has grown back to 36 pixels (was 18 before). It seems like the T-shape follows the face across the divider.
Now the face is on the right side where the T-shapes are. The goal might be to move the face to the yellow T position! Let me try moving DOWN and RIGHT to reach the yellow T.

Yellow T: row 45-53, col 51-59
To reach the yellow T, I need to move:
- DOWN: (45-12)/3 = 11 steps
- RIGHT: (51-30)/3 = 7 steps
But wait, now that the face is on the right side, does RIGHT still work the same way? Let me check if the face moves independently now or if it still affects the charcoal T.
Actually, looking at the image again, the charcoal T is now on the LEFT of the divider and the face is on the RIGHT. They swapped sides. The charcoal T is still a T-shape (36 pixels now vs original 45).
